name: auditing-signals
title_zh: 先看分布再谈相关性的数据体检员
tagline_zh: 拿到数据别急着跑模型：它先画分布、处理重尾，再用 CONFIRMED/OPPOSITE/MIXED/FALSE 给…
tagline_en: Before modeling, it plots distributions, handles heavy tails, and gives every hunch a verdict — CONFIRMED.
desc_en: Runs an honest EDA and signal audit — distributions first, heavy-tail handling, verdict-style mini-tests (CONFIRMED/OPPOSITE/MIXED/FALSE), sample-size floors. Use before modeling, when testing whether a popular belief shows up in data, or when a correlation looks too good.
why_zh: 它把「这相关看着太好了」当红灯，而不是当发现；先查分布和样本量底线，再决定这个信号配不配被相信。
why_en: It treats a too-good correlation as a red flag, not a finding — checking distributions and sample-size floors before deciding.
limit_zh: 只做审计不做建模：不替你选模型、不调参、不产出预测。样本量低于它设的底线时直接判 FALSE 并停下。
limit_en: Audit only, no modeling: it won't pick models, tune params, or predict. Below its sample-size floor it returns FALSE and stops — no weak 'for.
title_en: An EDA auditor that checks distributions before correlations
